gloss: to trim; to clip; to prune into shape

definitions.gloss: to trim; to clip; to prune into shape
definitions.explanation: To cut plants, hedges, or hair short and neatly, shaping them by cutting into the body of the growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生垣|いけがき}→生垣：18309_ikegaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}む。

examples.english: The gardener neatly trimmed the pine tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}んで、⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見違|みちが}えるようになった。
examples.english: After trimming the lawn short, the garden looked completely different.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧ (to mow, cut) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into, deeply). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of cutting into and shaping, not just cutting the surface.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{生垣|いけがき}→生垣：18309_ikegaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}む: to trim a hedge
- ⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}む: to trim the lawn
- ⟦{植木|うえき}→植木：04001_ueki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}む: to trim garden trees
- ⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧{刈|か}り{込|こ}む: to trim into a round shape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刈|か}る→刈る：02043_karu⟧: to mow, to cut — basic cutting without the shaping nuance
- ⟦{刈|か}り{取|と}る→刈り取る：21025_karitoru⟧: to harvest, to cut down — focuses on cutting and gathering, used for crops
- ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prune — formal gardening term for cutting branches to improve growth
- ⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to tidy, to arrange — more general term for making things neat
